messages:
maria: FYI CI perf failure on PR #9981 — microbench threshold diff on batcher and KV warmup. CI run: <https://ci.redwood.internal/2849501234|2849501234>. p95 generation +18% on small seq workloads.
trent: ugh ok can you paste the failing metric? is this on the new batching heuristic?
maria: p95 token latency went from 42ms -> 50ms, batch_wait_time p95 +22%, kv_cache_hit_first_200ms went 92% -> 67% (CI microbench).
kai: I changed the batcher wait policy in that PR (commit 8f1c3a2) and added a kv prefetch hook that runs when a request arrives but only on full batches. That was intended to reduce cold misses but might introduce jitter.
sana: that hitrate drop is consistent with prefetch not firing for partial batches. microbench runner spits out this: `kv_hit_first_200ms: 0.67, kv_total_hits: 0.81`. tail is suffering.
omar: can we bisect quickly? does main before merge show green?
luis: attaching a short local repro log: ```
[2026-03-18 10:21:03] batcher: batch_size=3 wait=8ms -> dispatch
[2026-03-18 10:21:03] kv_prefetch: triggered=false
[2026-03-18 10:21:03] latency: 46ms p50 84ms p95
[2026-03-18 10:21:04] batcher: batch_size=6 wait=1ms -> dispatch
[2026-03-18 10:21:04] kv_prefetch: triggered=true
[2026-03-18 10:21:04] latency: 44ms p50 60ms p95
```
maria: perf-bot threshold diff: `batch_wait_time.p95 +21.9% (breaks threshold 10%)`, `token_latency.p95 +17.8%`. This is blocking the PR. :exclamation:
perf-bot: Automated check: PR #9981 — CI perf microbench FAILED. Diffs exceed configured thresholds. Link: <https://ci.redwood.internal/2849501234/results|results>.
kai: quick hypothesis: prefetch only on full batches gives some requests no pre-warm; combined with the new wait policy there are more small early dispatches. I can flip prefetch to "always_attempt" (cheap async hint) or make wait_policy favor slightly larger windows.
sana: small change to always run async prefetch looks low-risk. can you benchmark locally with that toggle?
kai: testing now, results look promising locally: p95 down ~8% in microbench. patch: ```diff
- if (batch.size == batch_capacity) prefetch_kv(batch);
+ // attempt async prefetch for partial batches too; best-effort
+ prefetch_kv_async(batch);
```
omar: if local looks good, let's add a canary roll with 1% traffic and re-run the microbench in CI. If still bad we revert.
trent: agreement: canary + CI re-run. If CI still fails we mark rollout blocker and revert PR. Ping eng-oncall if we need immediate revert.
maria: filed canary job and re-run of perf microbench. CI re-run queued.
eng-oncall-bot: Noted — oncall alerted: @eng-oncall. If rollback needed, please tag with `rollback-needed`.
luis: thanks all, will monitor the re-run and post numbers.
maria: closing loop: if CI passes we ship the async prefetch tweak; if not, we revert and file follow-up to redesign prefetch gating. :thumbsup:
